first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: The dark-colored short-barreled handgun in the lower-right foreground, with a squared, angular slide; the grip area is partially occluded by a hand and the bottom edge of the frame.

entities.name: Animal A
entities.identification: The tall, slender, upright humanoid creature slightly left of the far end of the upper-level passage, with a brownish-tan upper body, long slender arms, and a gray lower body.

entities.name: group of light-colored small crab-shaped creatures
entities.identification: The group of low creatures in front of the hazardous horizontal bar; the central individual has a bulging light yellowish-brown body, and another limb-like portion occluded by the guardrail is visible on the right.

entities.name: riveted metal wall panel
entities.identification: The rectangular metal panels forming the indoor walls, with rivets arranged along both sides of the seams; they are bluish green in the earlier segment and light gray to bluish gray in the final frame.

entities.name: metal floor
entities.identification: The bluish-gray panel-like lower-level floor and the grayish-brown embossed upper-level floor.

entities.name: dark-colored metal ceiling
entities.identification: The dark-colored panel surface at the indoor ceiling, with parallel layered trim at the wall-ceiling junction; the upper-level ceiling surface is dark grayish green.

entities.name: metal ladder
entities.identification: The metal ladder mounted vertically against the wall and leading to the upper-level hatch, composed of side rails and multiple parallel rungs.

entities.name: hatch guardrail
entities.identification: The dark-colored angled guardrails on both sides of the hatch, whose bars have straight, angular edges.

entities.name: group of tall white canisters
entities.identification: The tall, light whitish canisters standing side by side at the end of the passage, with narrowed shoulders and dark-colored short necks at the top.

entities.name: hazardous horizontal bar
entities.identification: The dark-colored horizontal barrier in front of the group of canisters, with light-colored DANGER text on the red sign at its center.

entities.name: indoor light fixture
entities.identification: The set of rectangular light fixtures on the ceiling; in the final frame, a nearby bluish-white light and a distant warm-white light are visible.
